title: Social Security Legislation Amendment (Fair Debt Recovery) Bill 2017
short_title: Social Security Legislation Amendment (Fair Debt Recovery) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would suspend deductions from social security and family tax benefit payments while decisions to recover debts through those deductions are under review.
The Secretary would have to issue written declarations stopping relevant deductions during review, treating the deduction decision as ineffective while a declaration remains in force.
The changes would begin at Royal Assent and cover deduction decisions made before or after commencement, with declarations ending after review or earlier revocation.
changes: Family tax benefit deductions would be blocked during internal reviews initiated by the Secretary or the applicant.
Social security protection would extend to both instalment payments and arrears.
A declaration could take effect before the date it is issued.
summary.affected: People facing debt deductions from social security or family tax benefit payments and the Department of Human Services are affected.
